name: Lambert Conformal Conic (2SP) forward and inverse — NAD83(2011) / Texas South Central (EPSG::6360)

source.page: EPSG registry; EPSG Geomatics Guidance Note 7-2 §1.3.2.1 (Lambert Conic Conformal 2SP)
source.notes: Lambert Conformal Conic 2SP. Standard parallels 27°50'N / 31°53'N, latitude of origin 27°50'N, central meridian 99°W, false easting 600000 m, false northing 4000000 m, GRS80 ellipsoid. The ftUS variant is EPSG::6589 — the metre CRS is used so the sidecar's metre-native LCC matches false_easting_m/false_northing_m.

cases.name: San Antonio (29.4241°N, 98.4936°W → SPCS)
cases.notes: Cross-checked with scripts/verify_lcc.py (independent Python LCC), which is itself validated against the EPSG GN7-2 worked example (NAD27 / Texas South Central: 28°30'N, 96°W → E=2,963,503.91 ftUS, N=254,759.80 ftUS).

roundtrip_test.description: Forward then inverse must reproduce the input geographic coordinates to within 1e-9 deg (~0.1 mm).
